text:
Your Night Market poster is done. It's 4:5 with a burnt-orange background, cream lettering and a simple cream crescent moon.

Download (the link works for about 24 hours):
https://videos.magichour.ai/cmwbj7u6g05l0f1010aarb85s/output.png?X-Goog-Algorithm=GOOG4-RSA-SHA256&X-Goog-Credential=web-service%40magic-hour-385504.iam.gserviceaccount.com%2F20261111%2Fauto%2Fstorage%2Fgoog4_request&X-Goog-Date=20261111T030100Z&X-Goog-Expires=86400&X-Goog-SignedHeaders=host&X-Goog-

How I made it:
- The text-to-image tool can't make 4:5 images, so I made a tall version first. Then I used the image editor to rebuild it at 4:5.
- I used qwen-image-2.1, a free-plan model that's good at text. The image is 640px on its longest side, which is the free-plan maximum.
- It cost 20 credits: 10 for each step.

I couldn't preview the finished image, so please check the text. AI can misspell words or change the dash in "6–10". If anything is off, or you want a different font or layout, tell me and I'll make another version.
